## 更新内容

### 歌词同步

- 修复歌词固定落后 0–1 秒、且时有时无的问题（主窗口、任务栏、桌面歌词均受影响）。Cider REST 返回的播放位置是约每秒更新一次的快照，之前被当作实时位置推算，因此总会落后。
- 新增 Cider Socket 订阅：接收 `playbackStatus.playbackTimeDidChange` 推送，用其中的时间锚点校准本地时间轴。连接断开后每 5 秒重连，REST 轮询照常兜底；连接 Socket 不需要 Token。
- 最近 3 秒内收到过推送时，落后不超过 1.5 秒的旧 REST 样本会被忽略；REST 显示拖动进度、暂停或推送已过期时，仍以 REST 为准。推送里的时长与当前曲目不符时丢弃该样本，避免切歌时把新歌位置套到旧歌词上。

### 任务栏歌词

- 鼠标悬停再移开不再重置跑马灯滚动，离开后接续原进度。
- 右对齐时，歌词需要滚动也不再回退为左对齐：较短的行起步贴右，会溢出的行仍从左侧开始，循环接缝保持无缝。
- 未溢出时主歌词按自身宽度贴右，不再被较长的翻译带偏。

## 安装与升级

下载 `Lyrider_1.5.3.0_x64.msix` 和 `Lyrider.cer`，仅支持 Windows 11 x64。首次安装前，将证书导入当前用户的“受信任人”存储，再安装 MSIX：

```powershell
Import-Certificate -FilePath .\Lyrider.cer -CertStoreLocation Cert:\CurrentUser\TrustedPeople
Add-AppxPackage .\Lyrider_1.5.3.0_x64.msix
```

已有版本使用同一证书签名时，可直接安装新 MSIX 升级。安装包包含 .NET、Windows App SDK 运行时和中英文资源。

## 验证

- Release 构建 0 警告 0 错误；逻辑及服务测试（Release）：361/361 通过（新增播放时间轴与 Socket 事件解析测试）。
- 任务栏控件测试：55/56 通过，新增的右对齐与悬停测试均通过；唯一失败的 `QuickMenu_RightClick_OpensVerticalMenuAndAppliesSelectedCommands` 在 v1.5.2 上同样超时，与本版改动无关。
- 实机对比 4 轮：以 Cider 推送的播放起点为基准，旧逻辑平均偏差 −70 至 −807ms，新逻辑约 0ms。基准同样来自 Cider 推送，因此只能说明换算正确、REST 不再覆盖推送。
- 拖动进度、暂停/继续、Cider 断开重连、切歌仅有单元测试覆盖；任务栏跑马灯未在实机任务栏上目视确认。

相关 Pull Request：[#32 任务栏悬停重置滚动与右对齐滚动修复](https://github.com/Ayor1337/Lyrider/pull/32)、[#33 Cider Socket 播放时间轴校准](https://github.com/Ayor1337/Lyrider/pull/33)。

完整变更：[v1.5.2...v1.5.3](https://github.com/Ayor1337/Lyrider/compare/v1.5.2...v1.5.3)

## Changes in English

### Lyrics sync

- Fixed lyrics lagging 0–1 seconds behind, intermittently, in the main window, taskbar, and desktop lyrics. Cider's REST playback position is a snapshot refreshed about once per second and was previously projected as if it were live.
- Lyrider now subscribes to Cider's socket `playbackStatus.playbackTimeDidChange` events and uses their time anchor to calibrate the local timeline. It reconnects every 5 seconds after a disconnect, REST polling remains the fallback, and no Token is needed for the socket.
- While a push arrived within the last 3 seconds, stale REST samples up to 1.5 seconds behind are ignored; seeks, pauses, or an expired push still defer to REST. Pushes whose duration does not match the current track are dropped to avoid applying a new song's position to the previous lyrics.

### Taskbar lyrics

- Hovering and leaving no longer restarts the marquee; scrolling resumes where it was.
- Right-aligned lyrics no longer fall back to left alignment when they need to scroll: shorter lines start flush right, overflowing lines still start from the left, and the loop seam stays seamless.
- Non-overflowing main lyrics are right-aligned by their own width instead of following a longer translation.

### Installation and verification

Download `Lyrider_1.5.3.0_x64.msix` and `Lyrider.cer` for Windows 11 x64. For a first installation, import the certificate into the current user's Trusted People store using the commands above, then install the MSIX. Existing installations signed with the same certificate can upgrade directly.

The Release build had no warnings or errors, and all 361 logic/service tests passed. 55 of 56 taskbar widget tests passed; the one failure, `QuickMenu_RightClick_OpensVerticalMenuAndAppliesSelectedCommands`, also times out on v1.5.2. In four live comparisons the average offset dropped from −70 to −807ms to about 0ms, measured against Cider's own push anchor. Seeking, pause/resume, reconnects, and track changes are covered by unit tests only, and the taskbar marquee was not checked on a live taskbar.

Full changelog: [v1.5.2...v1.5.3](https://github.com/Ayor1337/Lyrider/compare/v1.5.2...v1.5.3)
